objective: Reduce invalid defect alarms without lowering the frozen 16/17 full-witness coverage; pursue zero false alarms with program analysis as the core and bounded semantic assistance.
requirements: Retain at least one complete correct failing witness for at least 16 of all 17 development trials.
Do not treat controls-pass plus generated-test-fail as proof of a patch defect.
Separate raw search candidates, semantically admissible alarms, uncertain candidates, and independent evaluation labels.
Measure complete-test invalidity separately from strict false initial defect alarms and mixed true-first-failure/later-invalid tests.
Use no case IDs, repository names, hidden verifier/reference code, or evaluation labels as algorithm decisions.
Test general transformations on independently authored variants and held-out candidates.
Preserve frozen baseline and report incremental-filter experiments separately from fresh synthesis runs.
Record real model calls, prompt/cache/reasoning/output tokens, runtime, and budget exhaustion.
Commit every implementation or experimental round; stop at the wall-clock deadline and preserve the best verified implementation.
first_round: Infer actual/expected roles through helpers and prove elementary type contradictions.
Check source-declared call and lexical-scope preconditions.
Require oracle applicability evidence before converting a failing search candidate into an alarm.
Compare admission on the full frozen failure inventory, the 16 positive witnesses, and independently evaluated negatives.
scope: Academic prototype. No LaTeX or PDF work. Baseline positive coverage does not establish generalized recall or issue-resolution improvement.
